# Truelancer

> > Truelancer is a global freelance marketplace offering AI services powered by 2M+ freelancers for machine learning training, data annotation, NLP, computer vision, and LLM operations.

Truelancer AI Services connects enterprises with a distributed workforce across Delhi, Manila, Nairobi, Munich, and Dakar for human-in-the-loop AI training data collection, annotation, and model evaluation. The platform specializes in NLP tagging, ASR, NER, computer vision (including LiDAR), content moderation, and prompt engineering with GDPR-compliant data handling.

## Key Topics

- Data Annotation
- AI Training Data
- Human-in-the-Loop
- NLP (Natural Language Processing)
- LLM (Large Language Models)
- Computer Vision
- ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition)
- NER (Named Entity Recognition)
- Prompt Engineering
- Speech Data Collection
- Audio Transcription
- Content Moderation (NSFW)
- Search Relevance
- Model Evaluation
- Global Workforce
